## Session Brief

* [F1: a seeded fresh-directory banking driver, its bundle record, and the σ gates' reader](F1.md) - Build the driver that re-banks every σ reference under D1 as amended (fresh seeds, a 4× screen, reported and equal-weight σ per seed), the bundle's per-seed record, and the gate reader. Inert until the user banks.
* [F2: the banking driver under D1's second amendment](F2.md) - Bank every row with hard_survey = 2, record each run's effective min/max_events, flag rows whose channels still scatter, and fail short-event or non-numeric runs; inert until banked.
* [HY1: hygiene review of the seeded banking driver](HY1.md) - Review F1 and F2's driver, seed-record binary and gate reader for maintainability, test non-vacuity and duplication; write findings first, then fix with mutation evidence.
* [V1: diagnostic fresh-directory seeds on the llj MLM rows](V1.md) - Measure whether fresh, independent MadEvent directories move the three llj MLM references, and measure MadEvent seed scatter and budget shift on a few cheap gated σ rows, as input to D1.

## Session Report

* [F1 report: the seeded banking driver, its bundle record and the σ gates' reader](F1-report.md) - bank-seeded-sigma re-banks each σ row as fresh-directory MadEvent seeds at the budget and 4×, keeps every channel's iterations, and writes output/seeded_sigma/<row>/seed_record.json; validate_sigma and validate_hadronic read a record where the bundle carries one and are unchanged without. Dry run on ee_to_mumu and pp_to_bb_fixed; validate unmoved. time_stages.py gains --nb-core.
* [F2 report: hard_survey = 2 on every banked run, the recorded survey, the heavy-tail flag and the run checks](F2-report.md) - bank-seeded-sigma sets hard_survey = 2 on every installed card, keeps each run's run_config.inc and event count, and refuses short-event or non-numeric runs (retried once). Seed record schema 2 carries the survey and every channel; seed-record prints SURVEY (INERT under the mmjj condition) and SCATTER (worst channel seed chi2/dof, flagged above 3). Dry run on ee_to_mumu and pp_to_bb_fixed; the flag's power at five seeds measured on the earlier cross-check's seeds.
* [V1 report: fresh-directory MadEvent seeds and scatter on gated σ rows](V1-report.md) - Twenty fresh-directory MadEvent seeds per llj MLM row leave the references where the shared-directory banks put them and scatter below their quoted errors as the shared seeds did. The ours-high offset on the rewgt rows is not a reference artefact. Five single-run hadronic rows scatter from 0.19 to 2.67 times their quoted variance. The CM-clustering fix (6740954), probed uncommitted, moves the rewgt rows' σ by −0.007 % paired per seed, a twentieth of the offset, and the pure-cut row not at all.
